local_wip.owner: Existing project WIP; next integrator must retain exact bytes and establish actual owner before editing.
local_wip.contract: Один worker/Auth lease; numeric-only cgroup v1/v2 or node-only memory sampler; bounded heavy-work admission/queues, Chromium idle cleanup, scheduling telemetry and resource-denial recovery. Current source and local-only docs/RESOURCE_MEMORY.md are canonical for this WIP.
local_wip.limits: Один heavy callback; до 8 очікувачів/30 s; browser queue до 4 включно з активною операцією. При відомому ліміті current+reserve <=0.9*limit; reserve192 MiB browser/PDF/DOCX preview,128 MiB інші. Один safe reclaim/recheck; невідомий limit не вигадується. Admission не є allocation cap або гарантією від OOM.
local_wip.recovery: Task resource denial → needs_input без автоматичного model-step; claimed effect лишається uncertain і потребує reconcile; media зберігає repair/materials; visual повертається в pending без decode-attempt та із cooldown30 s; cancel/forget/revision fences зберігаються.
local_wip.telemetry_privacy: Лише numeric sampler fields, timestamp, finite phase/kind; без тексту, URL, назв документів, arguments/results, chat/user/task/source IDs чи process command line. Logger failure не змінює outcome.
local_wip.validation: Source inspected for documentation. Existing/new product tests and long-session/Render memory acceptance not rerun or certified here.
local_wip.portability: docs/RESOURCE_MEMORY.md and six new tests/resource-memory.ts are untracked local-only inputs. A clean clone of HEAD lacks them; cold handoff must carry unchanged WIP bytes plus hashes, not only links.

limits: Source inspection only; 25 preserved CAP IDs. Presence does not prove enabled providers, correctness, runtime/model/account availability, current jobs, delivery or human acceptance. Committed source and local WIP have separate evidence. No product suite or live diagnostics run for this documentation migration.
source_scope: Current checkout at pinned HEAD plus preserved local resource-memory WIP; no product implementation changed by documentation migration.
